submissions.title: The Hotel Across the Street
submissions.verdict: The archive already contains The Shining (1977). The Hotel Across the Street is what you bring when you haven't read it.

submissions.title: Carrie 2.0
submissions.verdict: Carrie 2.0 wants to be Carrie. Carrie was Carrie.

submissions.title: Pet Cemetery
submissions.verdict: Pet Cemetery is the misspelling. Pet Sematary (1983) is on the shelf because it isn't.

submissions.title: Twelve Past Midnight
submissions.verdict: Four Past Midnight has four novellas. Adding eight more is a brand violation. Cortex flagged it as Bachman-adjacent; the Bachman novels disagree.

submissions.title: The Clown Below
submissions.verdict: Submitted by someone who's seen the IT (2017) adaptation but hasn't read the source. The source disagrees.

submissions.title: Werewolf in Maine
submissions.verdict: Compared against Cycle of the Werewolf (1983). The comparison was unkind to Werewolf in Maine.

submissions.title: The Long Sprint
submissions.verdict: The Long Walk (1979) walked 65 miles. Sprint is the wrong unit.

submissions.title: Annie Wilkes Returns
submissions.verdict: Misery (1987) is closed. The cobbler isn't unkilled by your enthusiasm.

submissions.title: Castle Rock Reborn
submissions.verdict: Reads like a Hulu pitch. Castle Rock is more than a brand; it's the postman, the bench, the Sheriff's office.

submissions.title: Doctor Sleep III
submissions.verdict: Doctor Sleep (2013) closed the Torrance ledger. Cortex flagged this as workshop draft of Doctor Sleep.

submissions.title: The Big Bad Cell
submissions.verdict: Cell (2006) already covered the phone-as-virus angle. Yours is the kind of pitch that ends "and then they realize the demon was inside them the whole time."

submissions.title: Stand By Me Forever
submissions.verdict: The Body became Stand By Me (1986) because it was already perfect. Sequel is a category error.
